decisions.reason: Turn 3 'What packages do you have?' directly presupposes B has cable packages available.

decisions.claim: B has multiple items/services beyond one package
decisions.reason: Turn 5 'What else have you got?' presupposes B has additional items/services beyond what was already discussed.

decisions.claim: B has cable packages to offer
decisions.reason: 'B has cable packages to offer' is bidirectionally equivalent to 'B has cable packages available' (c1); both derive from the same presupposition in turn 3.

decisions.claim: B offered or confirmed a package that includes basic and movie channels
decisions.reason: Turn 9 'Let me get that package' uses definite 'that' referring back to the basic+movie package from turn 7, necessarily implying B confirmed or offered such a package.

decisions.claim: B has additional offerings beyond the initially discussed packages
decisions.reason: 'B has additional offerings beyond the initially discussed packages' is equivalent to c2's 'B has multiple items/services beyond one package'; both stem from the presupposition in turn 5.

decisions.claim: B is the entity responsible for adding channels to A's service
decisions.reason: Turn 11 'can I add channels later?' presupposes B is the service provider responsible for managing channel additions to A's account.

decisions.claim: B presented a complete set of available options to A
decisions.reason: 'That's everything' in turn 11 is A's statement about what A has reviewed/seen; it does not entail B presented a complete set—A could have simply decided they've seen enough regardless of B's completeness.
decisions.counterexample: B might still have had more options to show, but A chose to stop the conversation.
